headline: Fronts Quiet, Fisherman's Row Flares in Latest Dispatch
war_summary: Since the 03:11 edition the wires have turned, with Fisherman's Row furnishing the only movement in the last two hours — three changes to a 04:34 cutoff, 32 on the day about Eidolo, Black Well and Dankana Post, holdings listed at two Warden, six Colonial and one destroyed. The busiest sectors have gone quiet since then: Weathered Expanse shows no changes in two hours after nine in six and 51 on the day to 03:11 about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, holdings six Warden and three Colonial with day losses of 8,525 Colonial and 13,782 Warden; Callahan's Passage shows none in two hours after 31 on the day to 02:43 about The Crumbling Passage, holdings eight Warden and two Colonial; Mooring County none in two after 12 on the day to 03:56, now ten Warden and two Colonial; Stlican Shelf none in two after 18 on the day to 01:20, four Warden and five Colonial; Palantine Berm and Linn Mercy also silent in two hours, last heard at 01:16 and 01:32.
